user.title: Sign in with SuperGrok
user.description: xAI only accepts the Grok CLI loopback (`{redirect_uri}`), not My Home Assistant. Browser login asks you to paste that callback URL. Device code skips the paste.

browser.title: Sign in with SuperGrok
browser.description:
1. Open [this SuperGrok sign-in page]({authorize_url}) and approve access.

2. After you approve, the browser goes to `{redirect_uri}` and fails to connect. That is expected.

3. Copy the **full URL** from the address bar (it contains `code=`) and paste it below. A bare authorization code also works.

models.title: Expose Grok to Home Assistant
models.description: Pick the chat models, Voice (TTS/STT), Realtime, and Imagine surfaces to create as Home Assistant entities.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Grok OAuth
reauth_confirm.description: Your SuperGrok session expired or was revoked. Sign in again to keep using Grok in Home Assistant.

progress.wait_for_authorization:
Open [{url}]({url}) on any device and approve access.

If asked for a code, enter: **{user_code}**

This page will continue automatically after you approve.

error.select_model: Select at least one model or capability.
error.missing_code: Paste the full localhost callback URL (it must contain code=), or just the authorization code.
error.state_mismatch: That callback does not match this sign-in attempt. Open the sign-in link again and paste the new URL.

abort.already_configured: This SuperGrok account is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach auth.x.ai to start SuperGrok login.

abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out waiting for SuperGrok approval. Start setup again.
abort.access_denied: Access was denied on the xAI authorization page.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different SuperGrok account.
abort.tier_blocked: This SuperGrok account is not entitled to the OAuth API surface.

abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out creating the SuperGrok authorize URL.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available to start OAuth.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The SuperGrok OAuth implementation is not available.
